text.0_Section, 0_Paragraph: Come, my lover, to welcome the bride
text.0_Section, 1_Paragraph: The face of Shabbat we will receive
text.1_Section, 1_Paragraph: We were caused to listen by the Unified God
text.1_Section, 2_Paragraph: Adonai is One, and His Name is One
text.1_Section, 3_Paragraph: To His name, and to glory and to praise!
text.2_Section, 0_Paragraph: To greet the Sabbath, come and we'll go
text.2_Section, 1_Paragraph: For she is a source of blessing
text.2_Section, 2_Paragraph: From the first, from of old, she was chosen
text.2_Section, 3_Paragraph: Made at the end, and planned from the start
text.3_Section, 0_Paragraph: O Holy Place of the King, city of sovereignty
text.3_Section, 1_Paragraph: Arise, escape from the midst of the chaos
text.3_Section, 2_Paragraph: Long have you sat in the valley of tears
text.3_Section, 3_Paragraph: And He will grant mercy, mercy upon you
text.4_Section, 0_Paragraph: Shake it off, from the ashes get up!
text.4_Section, 1_Paragraph: Put on the clothes of your glory, my people!
text.4_Section, 2_Paragraph: By the hand of the son of Jesse the Bethlehemite
text.4_Section, 3_Paragraph: Nearer to my soul is its redemption!
text.5_Section, 1_Paragraph: For your light has come! Get up, my light!
text.5_Section, 2_Paragraph: Wake up! Wake up! A song, speak out!
text.5_Section, 3_Paragraph: The glory of Adonai upon you is revealed!
text.6_Section, 0_Paragraph: Don't be ashamed! Don't be abashed!
text.6_Section, 1_Paragraph: Why be depressed? Why be upset?
text.6_Section, 2_Paragraph: In you my poor people will be sheltered
text.6_Section, 3_Paragraph: And she shall be rebuilt - the city on her hill!
text.7_Section, 0_Paragraph: And attacked shall be those who attack you
text.7_Section, 1_Paragraph: And far distant will be those who devoured you.
text.7_Section, 2_Paragraph: For you your God will rejoice
text.7_Section, 3_Paragraph: As a groom rejoices for his bride
text.8_Section, 0_Paragraph: Right and left you will break out
text.8_Section, 2_Paragraph: By the hand of the man of the line of Peretz
text.8_Section, 3_Paragraph: We will rejoice and we will sing
text.9_Section, 0_Paragraph: Come in peace, crown of her husband
text.9_Section, 1_Paragraph: As well in joy and in jubilation
text.9_Section, 2_Paragraph: The midst of the faithful precious nation
